title: On Adjusting the strap on the pack
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：adjust　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 adjust 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the postman ① adjusted the strap on the pack at once, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the postman ② adjusts the strap on the pack in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ adjust the strap on the pack at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ adjusted the strap on the pack before — a line in the list for June 1975 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Adjusting the strap on the pack at once, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ adjust to the shorter days in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Adjust to the shorter days at once and never mention it again.

By 1988 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new sender from the next office ⑧ adjusts to the shorter days at once every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the box, said nothing at all; she simply  adjusted the strap on the pack again when nobody else would.

To adjust the strap on the pack, my mother said in 1993, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody adjusts the strap on the pack in the rain again and somebody must adjust the strap on the pack at once all over again.

options: A. v. 调整（一般过去式 adjusted the strap on the pack：1981 年邮差头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 调整（一般现在 adjusts the strap on the pack：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 调整（不定式 to adjust the strap on the pack：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 调整（过去完成时 had adjusted the strap on the pack：1975 年六月的收发清单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 调整（动名词 adjusting the strap on the pack 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 适应（adjust to the shorter days：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去适应白天变短的日子）
G. v. 适应（adjust to the shorter days：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 调整（后段两处：新来的寄信人照例 adjusts to the shorter days，而母亲又一次 adjusted the strap on the pack）

answers: In 1981 the postman adjusted the strap on the pack at once, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the postman adjusts the strap on the pack in the rain whenever the office asks.
